Sitting leaders of more than 50 countries and territories have been assassinated or executed since 1972, per Wikipedia's running list. Some places lost several. Here is the map.

a thread 🧵🗺️

1/ Bangladesh is the starkest case on the list: President Mujibur Rahman (Aug 1975), Prime Minister Mansur Ali (Nov 1975) and President Ziaur Rahman (May 1981), all killed by army factions in under six years.

2/ Lebanon lost three: President-elect Bachir Gemayel (1982), Prime Minister Rashid Karami (1987) and President René Moawad (1989). Iran lost a president and a prime minister in a single attack on 30 August 1981.
3/ Some killings were tied to a movement. ETA killed Spain's prime minister Luis Carrero Blanco in December 1973, and India's Indira Gandhi was shot by her own bodyguards on 31 October 1984.
4/ Some were assassinated by one man. Egypt's Anwar Sadat was killed by soldiers led by Khalid Islambouli in October 1981, and Israel's Yitzhak Rabin by Yigal Amir in November 1995.
5/ Sweden's Olof Palme (1986) sits on the list with the assassin marked unknown, as do Lebanon's Karami and Moawad. The map shows where it happened, not who was behind it.
Note: the map's shading is a simplified take, and lists like this differ on who counts. What do you think is missing from it? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
